Privacy Policy & Client Data Protection

Last Updated: January 2026 | Compliant with Individual Privacy Act 2075 (Nepal)

Pathivara Law Firm Itahari ("we", "our", or "the firm") is committed to safeguarding the privacy and confidentiality of visitors, prospective clients, and retained clients who interact with our website and chambers services.

1. Legal Framework: Individual Privacy Act 2075

Our collection, processing, and retention of personal data strictly adhere to the provisions of the Individual Privacy Act 2075 (२०७५) of Nepal. Under Nepalese law, personal privacy regarding identity, communication, and legal documents is an inviolable fundamental right guaranteed under Article 28 of the Constitution of Nepal.

2. Information Collected via Website

When you submit a consultation request or contact enquiry through our website, we may collect:

  • Your full name and contact information (telephone number, email address).
  • The general subject matter or practice area of your inquiry.
  • Your preferred format and location for consultation.

We strongly urge users not to submit sensitive corporate secrets, confidential financial records, or detailed factual disclosures via unsecured online forms.

3. Advocate-Client Privilege & Confidentiality

Upon execution of a formal Vakalatnama and retainer agreement, all communications between the client and our legal team are protected by statutory legal professional privilege under Section 45 of the Evidence Act 2031 (Nepal). Such information will not be disclosed to any third party without explicit client consent, except where mandated by a lawful order of a competent Nepalese court.

4. Non-Disclosure & Security Measures

We do not sell, rent, or lease personal or contact data to commercial third parties. All electronic records are protected with industry-standard encryption and access controls.

5. Contact for Privacy Inquiries

For inquiries regarding our privacy standards or to request correction of your personal data, contact our chambers data compliance officer at info@pathivaralawfirmitahari.com.

Nepal Legal Notice & Ethical Disclosure: General Legal Information Notice: The legal analysis, procedural outlines, and statutory summaries on this website are published strictly for educational and public informational awareness in Nepal. This content does not constitute formal legal advice, nor does reviewing it establish an advocate-client relationship. Legal representation is only formed upon executing a formal Vakalatnama and retainer agreement under the Nepal Bar Council Code of Conduct 2051.
